Une journée comprend tous les blocs horo: A day includes every block timestamped from 00:00 UTC inclusive to the next midnight exclusive. The blocks before and after this interval are checked. A partial collection produces no daily total.
Les ratios comparent les fees aux états: Ratios compare fees with supply states and issuance estimates over the same blocks. The interval differs by a few seconds from the 86,400-second civil day; its actual duration is shown. Estimated issuance sums the estimates from each batch, without extrapolating fees. Spot prices are not used as historical daily prices; daily USD valuations remain unavailable.
Chaque ligne représente les blocs indiqu: Each row represents the specified blocks, never an extrapolated daily total. Duration runs from the previous block timestamp to the final block timestamp. The daily percentage measures time coverage, not a share of daily transactions or revenue.
Les fees collectées sont attestées par l: Collected fees are evidenced by tx/fee or fee_pay/fee and tip_pay/tip events. For some failed transactions, an ante transfer to the historical fee module, corroborated by debit and credit events, evidences payment. Tips are counted once and shown separately. If evidence is missing, collected fees and ratios are unavailable. Estimated issuance applies the rate and supply observed at the start of the window to its duration on a 365-day basis; it is not measured gross issuance. Supply change is net and cannot isolate burns. Fees are never subtracted from dilution.
Le prix affiché est le spot horodaté à l: The displayed price is the timestamped spot price at collection. Any resulting valuation is a valuation at collection, not a historical window price. Supply and inflation snapshots are accepted only if the provider confirms the historical height.
Les deux CSV historiques sont conservés: The two historical CSV files are preserved unchanged. Their block coverage and snapshot timestamps are unknown. Earlier USD prices, inflation rates, coverage ratios and dilution calculations are unvalidated and are not presented as reliable indicators. Archived fees are amounts declared in transactions, without evidence of a burn.
Ces mesures portent sur les paquets ICS2: These measurements cover ICS20 v1 packets sent through the transfer port, according to the provider’s transaction index. They depend on that index’s completeness and do not constitute an audit of every block. They are gross flows sent: acknowledgements, errors and refunds are not reconciled. IBC v2, NFTs, CCTP and other ports are excluded.
Une comparaison exige la même journée UT: A comparison requires the same UTC day fully covered in every index within the scope. The valued USD share covers only assets with known units and historical prices. Total USD share remains unavailable if any asset is unvalued. USDC is not arbitrarily fixed at USD 1.
Les prix sont des références historiques: Prices are historical daily CoinGecko references, not execution prices. Each valid price is frozen with its date and collection timestamp. Tokens are converted using their own Chain Registry units; raw amounts of different tokens are never added together.
Cette part des sorties mesure l'activité: This outgoing share measures relative activity within this scope. It proves neither universal routing centrality for the Hub nor an RWA market share. Multiple hops and return transfers can represent several sends for a single economic movement.
Entrées et sorties sont mesurées séparém: Incoming and outgoing flows are measured separately.
Les entrées confirmées sont les réceptio: Confirmed incoming flows are ICS20 v1 receptions with an interpreted success acknowledgement in the same transaction. Errors and missing confirmations are shown separately. This is not a measure of transit.
Entrées : {observed} réceptions observée: Incoming: {observed} observed receptions, {confirmed} with confirmed success, {errors} with error acknowledgements and {unknown} without an interpretable acknowledgement in the receive transaction. {unpriced} confirmed incoming packets without a valuation. Shares cover the confirmed subset; no transit or net balance reconciliation.

Les réceptions sont datées sur la chaîne: Receptions are dated on the destination chain. Only ICS20 v1 packets with a standard success acknowledgement interpreted in the receive transaction contribute to confirmed amounts. Error acknowledgements are excluded; missing, asynchronous or uninterpreted acknowledgements remain unconfirmed. Missing confirmation is never replaced with zero. Denominations are reconstructed using the receiving channel, stripping the sender prefix for returns to the source chain.
Ces entrées ne constituent ni un solde n: These incoming flows represent neither a net balance nor a measure of transit. A success acknowledgement does not prove final credit to the ultimate beneficiary across every hop. Sending and receiving dates may differ. Outgoing and incoming flows are not reconciled in this version.
